title: Smoother private access and richer community recipe details
summary: CloudlessOS 0.2.7-8 improves account sign-in over Tailscale, makes recipe details consistently accessible, and turns community ratings, comments, and vulnerability information into clearer, responsive controls.
changes: Complete account sign-in through the active Tailscale HTTPS hostname while keeping OAuth provider navigation outside the Cloudless dashboard and returning securely to the originating Spark.
Open the published community detail page from active recipes and recipes installed on this machine so users can inspect, rate, comment on, and report the exact release they are using.

Replace the previous rating controls with an immediate five-star interaction beside the recipe title, retain the signed-in user's rating across detail views, and refresh aggregate rating text after a vote.
Align block and report actions with the recipe title, remove duplicated community activity copy, and show a comment author's recipe rating beside their username when available.

Present known container vulnerabilities in a collapsed disclosure with visible SVG status icons, complete available package findings, and a plain-language explanation that distinguishes container software from model weights and clarifies local-versus-public exposure.

Keep launch-time vulnerability acknowledgement and risk guidance explicit while ensuring older validation records with summary-only evidence are described accurately instead of inventing missing package details.
Retire the GPT-OSS 20B, Qwen 2.5 1.5B, and older DeepSeek V4 Flash DSpark v0.26 SM121 starter recipe examples from the supported publication set.
Self-heal Cloudless-owned Docker networks at every container launch, including concurrent first-boot creation and a network disappearing immediately before Docker starts the container.
